subject.title: Owner-signed responsibility gates for assistant memory, actions, skills, and evidence reuse

question: What durable owner-confirmed responsibility lifecycle, if any, should OpenClaw support across memory, skill outputs, actions, and reusable evidence?
rationale: The decision affects security boundaries, persistent memory schema and retrieval, plugin SDK hooks, approval semantics, UI/audit state, and public configuration, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design the core/plugin responsibility contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define lifecycle states, storage/reuse semantics, plugin visibility, migrations, and how existing approvals and Skill Workshop participate.

options.title: Split into narrower canonical issues
options.body: Use this as an umbrella only, with separate implementation trackers for memory trust, skill governance, action approval, and evidence reuse.

options.title: Defer to external plugins or tools
options.body: Document SCBKR, UMP, MCP, or Memory Wiki-style approaches as optional workarounds unless a missing OpenClaw API is proven.

recommendation.title: Design the core/plugin responsibility contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define lifecycle states, storage/reuse semantics, plugin visibility, migrations, and how existing approvals and Skill Workshop participate.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across Skill Workshop approvals, memory host/plugin contracts, and security-sensitive policy docs relevant to this decision.
